services.desc:
For riders who are ready to take the next step beyond weekly lessons, leasing offers a meaningful increase in ride time, consistency, and connection with one horse.

At Unicorn Stables, leasing is a natural progression within our lesson program. It’s designed for riders who’ve built a solid foundation in lessons and are ready to develop more independence, deepen their horsemanship, and start working toward bigger goals. The consistency of working with the same horse week after week accelerates progress in a way that’s hard to replicate through lessons alone.
